swarm_review.round_1_candidate: Accept the current three observed cells as sufficient because validation isolates unseen-template transfer and frozen holdout adds unseen symbols.
swarm_review.round_1_rejection: The frozen holdout changes both template family and symbol pool. After a validation pass, a holdout failure still cannot distinguish symbol-OOD failure from a template-by-symbol interaction or from the second unseen template family being harder.
swarm_review.round_2_verdict: ADD_A_FROZEN_SYMBOL_ONLY_CELL_AND_SCORE_MAIN_EFFECTS_PLUS_INTERACTION; retain current generator as the sole binder lane and treat this as a diagnostic amendment, not a competing training authority.

finding.why_it_matters: Without the missing cell, symbol generalization is not separately identifiable from a joint template+symbol distribution shift at final evaluation.
finding.counterhypothesis: A compound OOD holdout is sufficient because only aggregate robustness matters.
finding.adjudication: That counterhypothesis is acceptable only for a compound-robustness claim. It is insufficient for the stronger Trigger-2 claim that episode-local binding generalizes to unseen symbols as a distinct capability.

required_repair.minimal: Add a frozen post-training SYMBOL_ONLY diagnostic using a known structural template family with an untouched symbol pool. It must not be used for tuning or checkpoint selection.
required_repair.stronger: Preregister a final 2x2 diagnostic over template_status {KNOWN,UNSEEN} x symbol_status {KNOWN,UNSEEN}; fully counterbalance S3 mappings, codebook display orders, query polarity, layout and semantic class within every cell.
required_repair.atom_pool_rule: If unseen-symbol cells share atom identities, open them only together after model freeze. If one cell is used for selection, use disjoint unseen atom pools and report that symbol-pool identity is an additional factor.
required_repair.family_rule: Keep causal/counterfactual siblings atomic by provenance_ancestry_id and counterfactual_family_id.
required_repair.model_visible_rule: Evaluator-only class IDs, split labels, mapping IDs, provenance labels and target metadata remain outside model-visible serialization.
required_repair.credit_rule: Behavioral success on this diagnostic cannot mint J-Space causal credit; same-model causal interventions remain separately required.

production_expansion_contract.acceptance_claim_boundary: Only make a distinct unseen-symbol generalization claim if the symbol-only cell passes its preregistered threshold without holdout reuse.

research_return.training_rule: Generalization factors that are named as separate capabilities need separate single-factor discriminators; a joint-OOD pass/fail alone cannot identify which capability changed.
research_return.harness_requirement: The future Xeno/HCU harness should report template main effect, symbol main effect and their interaction rather than one aggregate holdout score.
research_return.architecture_implication: If semantic-template transfer passes while symbol-only transfer fails, the bottleneck is closer to symbol binding/materialization than semantic reasoning; if the reverse occurs, target the semantic composition layer instead of increasing binder pressure.
research_return.distillery_implication: Do not mint accepted training utility from a corpus whose claimed generalization factor is only observable through a confounded final holdout.

next_exact_action: Amend the retained Trigger-2 evaluator/generator contract with a frozen known-template+unseen-symbol diagnostic cell before any pilot claim of distinct unseen-symbol generalization; keep exact ABI/tokenizer materialization and Forge/Distillery admission gates closed until checkpoint-local atoms and provenance are bound.
